title: 6 Best AI Online Course Creation Tools in 2026: Create & Sell Your Digital Course in Days
description: Discover the 6 best AI tools for creating and selling online courses as a solopreneur in 2026. Teachable vs Thinkific vs Kajabi vs Podia vs LearnWorlds vs CourseAI — build, market, and sell your first course without a production team.
content:
## The Solopreneur's Shortcut to Course Creation

If you've been sitting on expertise that could be a course — a skill you've mastered, a system you've built, a framework that works — 2026 is the year to finally ship it. The traditional model of online course creation was punishing: write a 50-page curriculum, record 20 hours of video, edit for weeks, build a website, set up payment processing, and then pray anyone finds it.

That model is dead.

AI has compressed the course creation timeline from months to days. Modern course platforms have built-in AI assistants that help you outline your curriculum, generate quiz questions, write marketing copy, create video captions, and even produce short promotional clips. For solopreneurs, this means you can test a course idea, build the content, and start selling in a fraction of the time and cost it used to require.

The $2.5 billion online course creation tools market has consolidated around six major platforms in 2026, and we've tested them all. This guide breaks down the **6 best AI-powered course creation tools** for solopreneurs, with real pricing, honest limitations, and the specific use case each platform serves best.


## At a Glance: The 6 AI Course Creation Tools Compared

| Tool | Best For | Starting Price | Transaction Fee | AI Features | Course Types |
|------|----------|---------------|-----------------|-------------|--------------|
| **Teachable** | Affordability & simplicity | $39/month (Basic) | 5% + $1 (Basic) | AI curriculum builder, quiz generator | Self-paced courses |
| **Thinkific** | Flexibility & scalability | $49/month (Basic) | 0% on Basic | AI course outline, AI assessment builder | Courses + communities |
| **Kajabi** | All-in-one business platform | $69/month (Basic) | 0% | AI content generator, AI email campaigns | Courses + marketing + sales |
| **Podia** | Creators who sell multiple formats | $39/month (Mover) | 0% | AI landing page builder, AI suggestions | Courses + digital downloads + memberships |
| **LearnWorlds** | Interactive & video-first courses | $29/month (Starter) | $5 + 0% (Starter) | AI video editor, auto-captioning, AI assessments | Interactive courses + mobile apps |
| **CourseAI** | AI-first course generation | $29/month (Creator) | 5% on Free, 0% paid | Full AI course generation from prompts | Rapid course prototyping |


## Teachable: The Solopreneur's Workhorse

Teachable has been a mainstay of the online course world for over a decade, and its 2026 update brings serious AI capabilities while keeping the simplicity that made it popular. If you want to create and sell courses without overthinking the tech, Teachable is your platform.

**What makes it different:** Teachable's AI Studio is a standout feature that helps you generate course outlines, quiz questions, and even entire course descriptions from a single prompt. The AI understands best practices in instructional design, so your generated content follows sound pedagogical structure.

**Standout features:**
- **AI Studio:** Generate course outlines, descriptions, and quiz questions from a topic prompt
- **TeachableU:** Built-in affiliate program where you can promote other creators' courses
- **Course completion certificates:** Automatically generated and branded
- **Built-in payment processing:** Stripe and PayPal integrated out of the box
- **No-code course builder:** Drag-and-drop curriculum organization

**Pricing:** Free plan includes 1 course, unlimited students, and $1 + 10% transaction fee. Basic at $39/month includes 5 courses, 0% transaction fees, and integrated affiliate marketing. Pro at $119/month includes 50 courses, advanced reporting, and course bundles. Business at $299/month for up to 200 courses.

**Limitations:** The free plan's 10% transaction fee is steep. Basic plan adds $1 per transaction on top of payment processing fees. The AI features, while solid, are less advanced than what CourseAI offers.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who want a proven, reliable platform with good AI features at an accessible price point.


## Thinkific: Maximum Flexibility, Zero Transaction Fees

Thinkific positions itself as the most flexible course platform for creators who want full control. Its AI tools have matured significantly, and its pricing structure — zero transaction fees on paid plans — makes it attractive for course creators with higher-priced offerings.

**What makes it different:** Thinkific's native AI assistant helps you build course outlines, draft lesson content, and create assessments. But the real differentiator is its flexibility: you can sell individual courses, create bundled packages, run membership sites, and build learning communities — all from one platform.

**Standout features:**
- **AI Course Outline:** Generate a complete course curriculum from a one-sentence topic description
- **AI Assessment Builder:** Create quizzes, assignments, and surveys with automatic grading
- **Learning communities:** Built-in discussion forums for student engagement
- **Bundles & subscriptions:** Sell course bundles or recurring membership access
- **Direct student messaging:** Communicate with students without third-party email tools

**Pricing:** Free plan includes 1 course, basic quizzes, and Thinkific branding. Basic at $49/month includes 3 courses and custom domain. Start at $99/month includes 5 courses and advanced AI features. Growth at $199/month includes 50 courses and priority support.

**Limitations:** The built-in email marketing is basic compared to dedicated tools like Mailchimp. More advanced features (like assignments and certificates) are gated behind the $99/month plan.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who plan to grow their course business over time and want a platform that scales without increasing transaction costs.


## Kajabi: All-in-One Course Business Platform

Kajabi is the most comprehensive platform on this list — it's not just a course creator, it's a complete business system with marketing automation, email campaigns, sales funnels, and a website builder. If you want to run your entire digital product business from one dashboard, Kajabi is the answer.

**What makes it different:** Kajabi integrates AI across its entire ecosystem. The AI content generator creates landing pages, email sequences, and social media posts in your brand voice. Its Pipeline Builder uses AI to suggest optimal sales funnel sequences based on your course topic and target audience.

**Standout features:**
- **AI Content Generator:** Write course descriptions, emails, landing pages, and social posts from prompts
- **Pipeline Builder:** Visual sales funnel builder with AI-optimized templates
- **Email Marketing:** Built-in email automations with segmentation and A/B testing
- **Website Builder:** Drag-and-drop site builder with AI-generated page layouts
- **Mobile app:** Students can access courses on Kajabi's native mobile app

**Pricing:** Basic at $69/month includes 1 product, 3 pipelines, and 10,000 contacts. Growth at $159/month includes 3 products, unlimited pipelines, and 25,000 contacts. Pro at $319/month includes 10 products and 100,000 contacts. All plans include 0% transaction fees.

**Limitations:** Kajabi is the most expensive option on this list. The $69/month entry point may be steep for solopreneurs just testing their first course idea. Some users find the platform overwhelming due to the sheer number of features.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who already have an audience and want an all-in-one solution to build, market, and sell their courses without juggling multiple tools.


## Podia: All Your Digital Products in One Place

Podia originally focused on simple course hosting, but has evolved into a platform that lets you sell courses, digital downloads, memberships, and coaching — all from one clean interface. Its AI features are lean but effective.

**What makes it different:** Podia's strength is its simplicity. It's the least overwhelming platform on this list while still offering everything you need to sell digital products. The AI landing page builder generates high-converting sales pages in seconds.

**Standout features:**
- **AI Landing Page Builder:** Generate a complete sales page from a product description
- **Multi-format selling:** Courses, digital downloads, memberships, and coaching side by side
- **Built-in email marketing:** Send broadcasts and set up automated sequences
- **Community features:** Built-in messaging and discussion for course students
- **No transaction fees:** On all paid plans, you keep 100% of your revenue

**Pricing:** Free plan includes 1 product and limited features. Mover at $39/month (billed annually) includes 10 products, email marketing, and 0% transaction fees. Shaker at $79/month (billed annually) includes 30 products, affiliate marketing, and embedded checkout. Earthquaker at $179/month (billed annually) includes 100 products and priority support.

**Limitations:** AI features are limited compared to Kajabi and LearnWorlds. No native mobile app for course delivery. The platform is better for simple courses than high-interactivity training programs.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who sell multiple types of digital products — courses, ebooks, templates, memberships — and want one clean platform to manage everything.


## LearnWorlds: Interactive, Video-First Course Experiences

LearnWorlds is built for creators who want to deliver the most engaging, interactive course experience possible. If video is the core of your teaching, and you want interactive elements like quizzes, annotations, and notes embedded directly in your video player, LearnWorlds is unmatched.

**What makes it different:** LearnWorlds' AI-powered video editor is unique. It automatically generates transcripts, captions, and interactive elements for your videos. The AI also creates custom assessments, learning paths, and completion certificates. It's the closest thing to a professional LMS (Learning Management System) that a solopreneur can use without a team.

**Standout features:**
- **AI Video Editor:** Auto-captioning, chapter markers, and interactive video elements
- **Interactive Video Player:** Embed quizzes, surveys, and CTAs directly into your videos
- **Branched Scenarios:** Create choose-your-own-adventure learning paths
- **White-label mobile app:** Publish your own branded mobile app (on higher plans)
- **AI Assessment Generator:** Create quizzes and exams with automatic grading

**Pricing:** Starter at $29/month includes 1 product, unlimited students, and $5 + 0% transaction fee. Pro Trainer at $99/month includes 3 products, certificates, and interactive video. Learning Center at $299/month includes 10 products, mobile app, and advanced reporting.

**Limitations:** The transaction fee on the Starter plan ($5 per transaction) can add up quickly. Advanced interactive features require the $99/month plan. The platform has a steeper learning curve than Teachable or Podia.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs creating video-heavy, interactive courses where student engagement and learning outcomes are the top priority.


## CourseAI: AI-First Course Generation

CourseAI is the newest and most radically different platform on this list. It's built entirely around AI — you describe what you want to teach, and the AI generates the entire course: outline, script, slides, quiz questions, and even a rough audio narration. It's designed for rapid course prototyping and testing.

**What makes it different:** CourseAI doesn't just help you create a course; it creates one for you based on your input. You provide the topic, target audience, and learning objectives, and the platform generates a complete draft course in under 30 minutes. You then review, edit, and customize before publishing.

**Standout features:**
- **Full AI course generation:** From topic to complete course in under 30 minutes
- **AI voiceover:** Generated audio narration for your slides
- **AI quiz and assignment generator:** Creates assessments aligned with your learning objectives
- **Multi-format output:** Generate written, video script, and slide-based versions of your content
- **Iterative refinement:** Give feedback and the AI revises the generated content

**Pricing:** Free plan includes 1 course with CourseAI branding and 5% transaction fee. Creator at $29/month includes 5 courses and custom branding. Pro at $79/month includes 25 courses and team collaboration. Enterprise for custom needs.

**Limitations:** AI-generated content requires careful review — it's a draft, not a finished product. The audio narration is clearly AI-generated, which may not suit premium-priced courses. Less suitable for advanced or highly specialized topics where the AI's knowledge may be shallow.

**Best for:** Solopreneurs who want to rapidly test course ideas before investing significant time in production. Also great for creating course outlines and first drafts that you then refine.

## FAQ: AI Online Course Creation

**1. Will AI-generated courses sound robotic?**
Only if you skip the editing step. AI tools generate excellent first drafts — outlines, scripts, quiz questions — but the best creators use AI as a starting point and layer in their unique voice, examples, stories, and expertise. CourseAI's output is a draft, not a finished product. Treat it like a smart assistant, not a replacement for your teaching.

**2. Do I need to record videos, or can AI handle everything?**
You can launch a course without recording a single video using CourseAI and text-based content. However, video courses consistently command higher prices and have better completion rates. Use AI to write your scripts and generate your slides, but consider recording at least an introductory video to establish a personal connection with students.

**3. Which platform is best for complete beginners?**
Teachable and Podia are the most beginner-friendly. Both have intuitive interfaces, strong onboarding materials, and customer support teams that understand first-time creators. Start with Podia ($39/month) for the simplest experience, or Teachable ($39/month) if you want slightly more advanced features.

**4. Can I migrate my course from one platform to another?**
Most platforms allow you to import/export course content, but the process varies. Video files and PDFs typically transfer easily. Quiz data, student progress, and custom platform features (like interactive video elements) often don't migrate. Plan to use your chosen platform for at least 6–12 months before considering a switch.

**5. Do I need my own website to sell courses?**
No. All six platforms provide hosted course pages with custom domains on paid plans. You can direct students to yourname.teachable.com or yourname.thinkific.com. If you want more control over your brand, each platform supports custom domain mapping on paid plans.


## Summary: Ship Your Expertise in 2026

The tools for creating and selling online courses have never been more accessible. The biggest barrier isn't technical anymore — it's the decision to start.

**Quick-start recommendations:**

1. **Test an idea with CourseAI** ($29/month) — Get a full course draft generated in 30 minutes to validate demand
2. **Launch your first real course on Podia** ($39/month) — Simplest platform for selling courses with zero transaction fees
3. **Scale up with Thinkific** ($49–$99/month) — More flexibility, communities, and zero transaction fees
4. **Go all-in with Kajabi** ($69/month) — If you want an entire business platform with marketing automation built in
5. **Differentiate with LearnWorlds** ($29–$99/month) — If your course is video-heavy and interactive

Your expertise is valuable, and there's an audience out there waiting to learn from you. Pick the platform that fits your budget and skill level, use the AI tools to accelerate your production, and publish your course this month. The only thing you lose by waiting is revenue.
